reviews.review:
So many people are purposefully ignorant just bc they think they deserve to win every single game on super helldive and can't take the pride hit of just turning down the difficulty to actually enjoy the game. Not to mention the fact that you're just not always going to win. It's a PvE game it's not like someone else benefits from your loss it's simply just part of the experience, and the experince on the hardest difficulty is meant to be HARD believe it or not. 

A lot of people are seemingly mad bacause the devs are making what they want to make and not personally changing thier vision to satisfy each individual whining abt "bad balance". Besides, the ppl who talk abt "bad balence" are oftentimes the ppl who don't seem to understand that having a primary weapon that one shots everything kinda nullifies strategems AKA a core mechanic the entire game rests upon. Why bother calling in a mech or an airstrike when ur primary can clear hordes of heavily armored enemies with no effort. If your strategy isn't working then maybe it's time for a new strategy, everything in the game has a weakness and everything can be killed by a number of different weapons and not every single weapon is meant for every single situation.

I do think the bug complaints are valid, but if you like the game I don't see the point on turning your back on the game and renouncing it and Arrowhead like they've betrayed you when they still very consistently patching the game and are working to fix bugs. Bugs and instability suck but people act like the devs have completely abandoned the game or somthing and it's absolutely absurd. Just because they didn't instantly fix that one issue that killed you and made you ragequit in the last round you played doesn't mean they never will. Things take time and the bug fixes are definitely a lot more complex than anyone who isn't directly working on the game can understand. Just have patience, dying due to a glitch or having the game crash sucks, but it's still being patched and worked on consistently and it's still very playable.

It's not a game for everyone, and if you find yourself constantly whining and complaining about a game there's a good chance that maybe you just don't like it, and that's OK. but it's important to remember that this game is Arrowhead's vision, not yours. If you don't like Arrowhead's vision that's fine you don't have to play the game but calling them a bad company because they make what they want and not only what you want is rediculous.
